newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks bounce back to end higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks bounce back to end higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed slightly higher on Wednesday, led by strength in blue chips, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The Karachi 100-index closed 2.32 points, or 0.13 percent, up at 1,813.16, after falling to 1,803 in early trading. Losers led gainers 137 to 111 at the close at 14.15 p.m. (0915 GMT).
Prices opened lower on a technical correction following sharp increases in the past few sessions, dealer Azhar Batla said. Blue chip buying later pulled the market higher, he added.
Shell Pakistan rose 8.00 to 285 and Lever Bros 5.00 to 870. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
